scope: frontend request behavior and provider logic
implemented_changes: CapabilityStateProvider now uses auth-keyed single-flight bootstrap guards and cached refresh behavior.
apiRequest now runs through a frontend request cache with in-flight dedup and max six active requests.
AdapterAccessProvider consumes capability snapshots and has a 60s derived memory cache.
ModuleAccessProvider consumes the capability module snapshot and does not call /modules/me directly.
OperationsDashboard does not call capability refresh on mount.
